messages:
emma: Quick design thread  Exporting eval runs -> customers want a printable report (PDF/CSV) with accessible captions and clearer column labels. Sketch: https://redwood.mock/fig/export-report-v1.png

emma: Key asks from research: include failure examples, human-readable captions, a legend that's colorblind safe, and a short executive summary at top (one sentence).

rishi: For the CSV we already have fields: example_id, prompt, output, delta, status. Request: add `failure_summary` and `severity_label` and use 'Success rate' not 'pass_rate'.

clara: PDF layout: top header with run name, date, summary sentence, then table of failing examples with context and a right column for annotator notes. Keep fonts large enough for print.

zack: Accessibility: PDFs must include text layers (not just images) for screen readers. Also, the legend must include ASCII labels (e.g., [Severe] instead of only color).

a11y-bot: a11y-scan: recommended alt text for example screenshots, readable table headers, and tagged PDF semantics. Flagging that exported SVG legends need title/desc elements.

emma: Microcopy: change header "Regression" -> "Delta vs baseline  lower is better" and add a 1-line explainer in the summary: "Negative delta means model improved; positive means regression." Keep it short.

rishi: Implementation note: CSV/JSON exports should include a `legend` object (but remind: all fields must be strings). For PDFs we'll render legend visually and include a textual legend section below the header.

clara: Also internationalization: executive summary will be auto-generated, but must be localized. i18n-bot: please make sure we have templates for `summary_positive` and `summary_negative` so translators can handle grammar.

i18n-bot: i18n-scan: flagged. Create keys `export.summary.positive` and `export.summary.negative` and mark them for translators. Also avoid concatenating numbers+strings in code to keep pluralization safe.

zack: Print note: many customers paste PDFs into docs; include a high-contrast PNG legend block that can be copy-pasted. Also provide an option: include full tokens/kv caches? (probably not) default: omit low-level logs.

emma: UX decision proposal: default export includes exec summary, textual legend, failing example table with short prompt+output snippet (truncate to 240 chars), severity label, delta, and optional annotator notes. Advanced toggle: include full prompt and outputs.

rishi: CSV column names to ship: run_name, run_date, exec_summary, example_id, prompt_snippet, output_snippet, delta, severity_label, failure_summary, annotator_notes. Use snake_case to match other exports.

clara: PDF visual tweaks: use Okabe-Ito palette for legend, 14pt body font, 16pt headings, and a small monospaced block for examples that came from code-style outputs.

a11y-bot: For PDFs ensure tagged reading order: header -> summary -> legend -> table. Also include language tag at the document level.

emma: One more microcopy ask: for severity_label use 'Severe', 'Moderate', 'Minor' instead of adjectives like 'regressed' so it's neutral and easier to translate.

rishi: Backwards-compat note: alerts that rely on numeric sign may need to map to severity label via thresholds. We'll document mapping in API changelog.

clara: Action items: @rishi add new CSV columns + API docs, @clara produce PDF mock with text layers and legend, @zack add PDF tagged semantics and alt text checklist, @emma write the one-line summary templates and pass to i18n.

emma: Decision summary: default export includes exec summary (localized), textual legend with Okabe-Ito colors plus ASCII labels, failing examples table truncated to 240 chars with severity labels (Severe/Moderate/Minor), PDF must be tagged and include text layer. Advanced toggle for full content.

zack: I'll draft a checklist for the engineering PR: tagged PDF, alt text, legend title/desc, language tag, and attach sample output.

rishi: I'll update export schema and add a migration note.

clara: Will share the PDF mock tomorrow. Thanks! :raised_hands:
